(()=>{const upper=document.querySelector('[aria-label="3D view controls"]'),lower=document.querySelector('[aria-label="Model navigation"]');for(const name of ['Fly','Walk-through']){const b=[...upper.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent===name);if(!b||b.disabled)throw Error('Missing/disabled '+name);const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.top<0||r.bottom>innerHeight||!b.contains(document.elementFromPoint(r.left+r.width/2,r.top+r.height/2)))throw Error('Unreachable '+name);}if(lower?.querySelectorAll('button').length!==5)throw Error('Bottom navigation missing');return {Fly:'reachable',WalkThrough:'reachable',bottomControls:5}})()
